reports.clinicalText:
MRI RIGHT KNEE
HISTORY: Locking episodes, ?meniscal injury.
TECHNIQUE: Axial, coronal and sagittal PD fat-sat and PD sequences.
FINDINGS:
ACL and PCL are intact.
Medial meniscus is intact. There is no displaced meniscal flap or extrusion. There is full-thickness cartilage loss in the inner
weightbearing surface of the medial femoral condyle. Intact articular cartilage on the medial tibial plateau. MCL is intact.
Lateral meniscus is intact. There is a chronic full-thickness cartilage defect in the lateral tibial plateau inner posterior aspect,
measuring 12 x 14mm, with some evidence of remodelling. Mild degeneration of the proximal LCL attachment. No acute tear or
sprain. Biceps femoris and popliteus tendons appear normal. Minimal oedema adjacent to the distal ITB.
Full-thickness cartilage loss in the lateral patellar facet superiorly with underlying subchondral cystic change and oedema. Moderate-
grade chondral wear in the femoral trochlea centrally with full-thickness chondral fissuring in the medial femoral trochlea inferiorly.
Hoffa's fat pad appears normal.
There is tendinosis of the proximal patellar tendon and enthesopathy of the distal quadriceps and proximal patellar tendon.
Small knee joint effusion. No intra-articular loose body is seen. No Baker’s cyst.
Neurovascular structures appear normal.
CONCLUSION:
No meniscal tear.
Areas of full-thickness cartilage loss in the medial femoral condyle, lateral tibial plateau, patella and femoral trochlea.
Moderate proximal patellar tendinosis.
Small knee joint effusion.
Radiologist: Dr S. McDonald
reports.translation:
右膝磁共振

病史：膝关节交锁发作，疑半月板损伤。

检查技术：轴位、冠状位及矢状位质子密度加权脂肪抑制（PD fat-sat）及质子密度加权（PD）序列。

影像所见：
前交叉韧带（ACL）和后交叉韧带（PCL）完整。

内侧半月板完整。未见移位的半月板瓣片或半月板外突。股骨内侧髁负重面内侧部分可见全层软骨缺失。胫骨内侧平台关节软骨完整。内侧副韧带（MCL）完整。

外侧半月板完整。胫骨外侧平台内后部可见慢性全层软骨缺损，大小12 × 14 mm，伴一定程度的重塑征象。外侧副韧带（LCL）近端附着处轻度退变。未见急性撕裂或扭伤。股二头肌腱及腘肌腱形态正常。髂胫束（ITB）远端邻近可见极少量水肿。

髌骨外侧关节面上部可见全层软骨缺失，伴其下方软骨下骨囊性改变及水肿。股骨滑车中央可见中度软骨磨损，股骨滑车内侧下部可见全层软骨裂隙。

Hoffa脂肪垫（髌下脂肪垫）形态正常。

髌腱近端可见肌腱病变；股四头肌腱远端及髌腱近端可见附着点病变。

膝关节少量积液。未见关节内游离体。未见Baker囊肿（腘窝囊肿）。

神经血管结构形态正常。

结论：
未见半月板撕裂。
股骨内侧髁、胫骨外侧平台、髌骨及股骨滑车存在局灶全层软骨缺失。
髌腱近端中度肌腱病变。
膝关节少量积液。

放射科医师：Dr S. McDonald

reports.clinicalText:
CT RIGHT KNEE
HISTORY: Right medial knee pain after walking. Tenderness over insertion of right MCL insertion, ?MCL sprain.
TECHNIQUE: Noncontrast CT of the right knee.
FINDINGS:
No acute fracture is demonstrated. Mild medial and lateral compartment degenerative change with small osteophytes and minimal
joint space narrowing. No abnormality seen in relation to the medial or lateral collateral ligaments within the limitations of CT. No
large meniscal tear or extrusion is appreciated on CT.
There is subchondral cystic change in the lateral patellar facet superiorly in keeping with full-thickness cartilage loss. There are mild
to moderate degenerative changes at the proximal tibiofibular joint. Mild enthesopathy of the distal quadriceps and proximal patellar
tendon insertion. Small patellofemoral osteophytes.
Trace knee joint effusion. No large Baker's cyst. No calcified intra-articular bodies. Mild vascular calcification. Enthesopathy at the
posterior tibial and soleal line noted.
CONCLUSION:
Patellofemoral compartment degenerative changes with full-thickness cartilage loss in the lateral patellar facet.
Mild medial and lateral compartment degenerative changes.
No evidence of high-grade MCL injury on CT. Ultrasound or MRI would better assess the soft tissues.
Radiologist: Dr S. McDonald
reports.translation:
右膝CT

病史：行走后右膝内侧疼痛。右膝内侧副韧带（MCL）附着处压痛，疑内侧副韧带扭伤。

检查技术：右膝非增强CT。

影像所见：
未见急性骨折。内、外侧关节间室轻度退行性改变，伴小骨赘及轻微关节间隙变窄。在CT检查的局限范围内，未见内侧或外侧副韧带异常。CT未显示较大的半月板撕裂或半月板外突。

髌骨外侧关节面上部可见软骨下骨囊性改变，符合全层软骨缺失。上胫腓关节轻至中度退行性改变。股四头肌腱远端及髌腱近端附着处轻度附着点病变。髌股关节可见小骨赘。

膝关节微量积液。未见较大的Baker囊肿（腘窝囊肿）。未见钙化性关节内游离体。轻度血管钙化。胫骨后方及比目鱼肌线处可见附着点病变。

结论：
髌股关节间室退行性改变，伴髌骨外侧关节面全层软骨缺失。
内、外侧关节间室轻度退行性改变。
CT未见内侧副韧带重度损伤的证据。超声或磁共振可更好地评估软组织。

放射科医师：Dr S. McDonald

CT THORACIC AORTIC ANGIOGRAM
CLINICAL HISTORY:  Yearly review Post AVR, ascending aortic replacement and hemiarch
replacement.
Comparison made with previous CT the aorta from 29/10/2024.
TECHNIQUE:
MD CT scans were obtained through the thoracic aorta following the angiogram protocol. The aorta
was analysed on the GE volumeshare workstation and measurements obtained.
REPORT:

Previous aortic valve replacement, ascending aorta and hemi arch replacement is noted.

Aortic Arch Branches:
Innominate: It has conventional anatomy & no stenosis is seen.
Left common carotid: There is no significant atheroma at its origin or stenosis.
Left subclavian: There is minor calcified atheroma at its origin with less than 25% stenosis.
Descending aorta:
There is scattered calcified atheromatous disease is present.
Heart:
The coronary arteries have conventional origins and there is scattered coronary artery calcification.
The heart is not enlarged. No pericardial effusion is seen.
Mediastinum:

There is no mediastinal or hilar lymphadenopathy. The solid nodule abutting the lower oesophagus
in the posterior mediastinum is again noted measuring 20 x 17 mm (previously 22 x 18 mm on the
MR from 10/4/2025.)
Since the previous study, there has been interval development of extensive venous collaterals
throughout the thorax, raising the possibility of a central venous stenosis at the level of the
innominate vein.
Lungs & Pleural spaces:
No focal consolidation is seen. There is a stable 6 mm left upper lobe pulmonary nodule. No other
suspicious pulmonary nodules or mass.
No emphysematous change is present. No pleural fluid collection is seen and there are no pleural
plaques.
Supra-clavicular region & axilla:
No lymphadenopathy is seen. The thyroid is not enlarged.
Other:
No rib lesion or fracture is identified. No destructive vertebral body lesion is seen.
CONCLUSION:
Interval ascending aorta and hemiarch replacement.
Development of new extensive venous thoracic collaterals, likely due to innominate vein stenosis.
Stable appearance of the posterior mediastinal nodule abutting the lower oesophagus and the left
upper lobe nodule.
Radiologist: Dr D. Ravindran
reports.translation:
胸主动脉CT血管造影

临床病史：主动脉瓣置换、升主动脉置换及半弓置换术后年度复查。
与29/10/2024的主动脉CT比较。

检查技术：
按血管造影方案进行胸主动脉多排CT扫描。在GE VolumeShare工作站上分析主动脉并进行测量。

报告：
主动脉弓：可见既往主动脉瓣置换、升主动脉及半弓置换术后改变。

部位｜既往大小｜本次大小
主动脉瓣环｜22 × 29 mm｜19 × 30 mm
Valsalva窦（主动脉窦）｜38 × 43 mm｜39 × 40 mm
窦管交界｜39 × 41 mm｜36 × 40 mm
升主动脉中段｜48 × 50 mm｜29 × 32 mm
升主动脉远段｜44 × 46 mm｜33 × 39 mm
主动脉弓中段（左颈总动脉与左锁骨下动脉之间）｜35 × 37 mm｜36 × 39 mm
主动脉弓远段｜28 × 33 mm｜29 × 33 mm
降主动脉近段｜28 × 29 mm｜28 × 30 mm

主动脉弓分支：
头臂干（无名动脉）：解剖走行常规，未见狭窄。
左颈总动脉：起始部未见明显粥样斑块或狭窄。
左锁骨下动脉：起始部少量钙化性粥样斑块，狭窄程度小于25%。

降主动脉：散在钙化性动脉粥样硬化病变。

心脏：冠状动脉起源常规，可见散在冠状动脉钙化。心脏未增大。未见心包积液。

纵隔：未见纵隔或肺门淋巴结肿大。再次显示后纵隔紧贴食管下段的实性结节，大小20 × 17 mm（10/4/2025磁共振上为22 × 18 mm）。
与前次检查相比，胸部新出现广泛静脉侧支循环，提示可能在头臂静脉（无名静脉）水平存在中央静脉狭窄。

肺及胸膜腔：未见局灶性实变。左肺上叶6 mm肺结节稳定。未见其他可疑肺结节或肿块。未见肺气肿改变。未见胸腔积液或胸膜斑。

锁骨上区及腋窝：未见淋巴结肿大。甲状腺未增大。
其他：未发现肋骨病变或骨折。未见椎体骨质破坏性病变。

结论：
自前次检查后已行升主动脉及半弓置换。
胸部新出现广泛静脉侧支循环，可能由头臂静脉狭窄所致。
紧贴食管下段的后纵隔结节及左肺上叶结节表现稳定。

放射科医师：Dr D. Ravindran
